A '''operative''' was a member of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police Force]] conducted a [[Raid in the Entertainment District|raid]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]] during which the operative was killed by [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] [[Raim Tibekk]].
